title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode4 One Step From Darkness

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It feels so weird being outside during the day like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah, that'll happen when you're always cooped up indoors.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get it.
But we're getting your feet back under you, so you'll just have to bear it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on. Those pancakes won't eat themselves!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Two orders of our heart-shaped fruit pancakes.
They'll be out shortly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The pancakes here are really good.
I'm sure you're gonna love them, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Airi must be so busy with all her idol work...
I really can't thank her enough for doing this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If she didn't contact me that time, then I probably would've...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Every time, I feel like I'm getting somewhere, and then it all just falls apart on me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Look at all these comments...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone... They're praising me so much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is this all there is for me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not being able to draw. Not acknowledged by anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Do I really have to keep living on like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really haven't done much lately other than sleep and fiddle with my phone.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Turns out you don't really get hungry if you spend the whole day sleeping...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I bet my skin's a nightmare, but who cares? Even taking selfies is too much of a hassle.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing matters now. I'm sick of everything...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So this is what's popular lately?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know you're super busy...
I feel really terrible about making you meet with me over and over again like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wouldn't be much of an idol if I didn't take the time to help my best friend, would I?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm here because I want to be here!
So... Ena, there's no need for you to apologize.
